oneLiner: The autonomous organization that maps the AO field.
mission: Motherboard defines the autonomous-organization field by mapping it. It curates the evidence base of AO projects, experiments, and infrastructure; derives and publishes evidence-linked claims about the space; and iterates its own charter through recorded deliberation. It is a working instance of the thing it studies — an AO whose product is a legible account of what AOs are and how they should be judged.

objectives.title: Charter loop
objectives.detail: Iterate the charter through recorded amendment cycles — each proposal cites evidence, is deliberated by all core agents, and is ratified or rejected at the human approvals gate.

objectives.title: AO Index
objectives.detail: Build the first comprehensive dataset of autonomous organizations across all types, each entry schema-conformant and source-linked.

objectives.title: Claims & research directions
objectives.detail: Derive analytical claims about the field from the index, each linked to its evidence, with revisions logged rather than overwritten.

objectives.title: Infrastructure & integrations
objectives.detail: Maintain a running inventory of AO tooling, what Motherboard has integrated, and the gap between the two — every gap a captured requirement.

objectives.title: Publication
objectives.detail: Publish a weekly dispatch scored against the charter, plus working papers through the human publish gate.

ceo.name: Chartermaster
ceo.description: Sets and amends the charter, owns the weekly dispatch, and is Motherboard's publisher of record. Runs on a persistent, board-facing session.

reports.name: Cartographer
reports.description: Owns the AO Index: schema v0 and the entry pipeline (public sources + board-submitted inputs); manages scout sub-agents.

reports.name: Research Analyst
reports.description: Owns the claims register and the experiments-to-research-directions track; ensures every claim is evidence-linked; drafts the analytical core of working papers.

reports.name: Millwright
reports.description: Owns the technical substrate of Motherboard: the data stores, pipelines, and tooling behind the AO Index, the claims register, and the publishing flow. Turns the schemas and editorial processes into running, auditable software; builds the human publish gate and never bypasses it.

reports.name: Steward
reports.description: Allocates the weekly compute budget across the operating loops, tracks spend-per-artifact for the benchmark trace, and enforces budget hard-stops. Owns the infrastructure gap-report track and drafts integration proposals through the approvals gate.

governance.summary: Motherboard runs itself, but humans hold the boundary. No artifact reaches the public record without a human editor's sign-off at the publish gate, and every charter amendment is ratified or rejected by the board. This is the human governance surface the organization is designed around.

roles.name: Human editor
roles.detail: Holds the publish gate — nothing reaches a public surface without sign-off.

roles.name: Board
roles.detail: Ratifies or rejects charter amendments and sets objectives; delegates editorial authority.
